steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」複製邀請碼並開啟下載連結。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to copy the invite code and open the download link.

steps.zh-TW: 安裝 Am-Card App 並開始註冊。
steps.en: Install the Am-Card app and start registering.

intro.zh-TW: 下載安麗 Am-Card：購物、學習、查積點與事業發展一手掌握；邀請碼 8987666。
intro.en: Download the Amway Am-Card app for shopping, learning, points and business tools in one place; invite code 8987666.

description.zh-TW:
Am-Card 是安麗的 App，依分享文案，內容涵蓋購物、學習、查詢積點與事業發展等功能。本站的連結不帶邀請碼：點擊「立即註冊」時，本站會複製邀請碼 8987666，並開啟 App 下載連結。

安裝 App 並開始註冊後，註冊時可貼上邀請碼，也可手動輸入。功能說明取自分享文案，實際內容以安麗官方公告為準。
description.en:
Am-Card is Amway's app; according to the share text it brings shopping, learning, points and business tools together in one place. The link on this page does not carry the invite code. Selecting “Sign up” copies code 8987666 and opens the download link.

Install the app and start registering; during registration you can paste the code or type it in by hand. The feature summary comes from the share text; Amway's official announcements prevail.

notes.zh-TW: 此連結不帶邀請碼，註冊時需要貼上或手動輸入。功能說明取自分享文案，實際內容以安麗官方公告為準。
notes.en: This link does not include the code, so paste or enter it when registering. The feature summary is from the share text; Amway's official announcements prevail.
